description: ETL helper table for decoding intents

schema.description: The GCP project ID of the agent
schema.name: agent_project_id

schema.description: The GCP location of the agent
schema.name: agent_location_id

schema.description: The user-provided identifier for the agent
schema.name: agent_id

schema.description: The unique ID of the intent
schema.name: intent_id

schema.description: The human readable name of the intent
schema.name: intent_name

schema.description: Whether the intent is a head intent
schema.name: head_intent

schema.description: The timestamp from which the intent is valid
schema.name: valid_from

schema.description: The timestamp until which the intent is valid
schema.name: valid_to
